summary: Iteration 5 covered both backend and frontend testing for scheduled breaking headlines + admin login fix. Backend: wrote 17 new pytest cases (backend_test_phase5.py) exercising POST/PUT /api/breaking with start_at/end_at scheduling, malformed date rejection, end<=start rejection, empty-string clearing, backward compat and auth. All 17 pass against the public preview URL (https://0c2b6ec2-...preview.emergentagent.com). Also re-ran the 27 phase4 tests — all 27 pass (2 test-side selector fixes were required because main agent tightened the slug validator to ^[a-z0-9-]+$ so the previous underscore-based slugs now correctly return 400; test file updated accordingly). Frontend: verified admin login (rahipatrika@gmail.com / Thanksc#2u) redirects to /admin, header dropdown reachable, /admin/breaking form has datetime-local Start at / End at, creating items with no schedule → Live badge, future start → Scheduled badge, past end → Expired badge, and the public home-page ticker correctly hides Scheduled and Expired items while showing Live ones. /admin/categories, /admin/sidebar, /admin/layout all reachable. Total: 44/44 backend pass, all frontend flows pass. No new bugs.

minor.issue: Right-side auto-topup skip_offset = remaining still uses variable skip when curated items exist (carried over from iteration 4). Consider set-difference over full latest list.

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/breaking: the update filter `{k: v for k,v in payload.model_dump().items() if v is not None}` drops fields whose new value is None; that is intentional so callers can leave fields untouched. However this means callers cannot clear a field by sending null — they must send "" (empty string). That contract is documented in the AdminBreaking.js UI but should be noted in API docs.
server.py is now ~1408 lines; consider splitting into routers modules for maintainability (auth, articles, breaking, categories, sidebar, layouts, health, newsletter).
_parse_iso silently returns None for invalid input; the create/update handlers explicitly check `payload.start_at and not _parse_iso(...)` — correct and well-guarded.

GET /api/breaking iterates in Python for live filtering (small collection ≤500). Fine at current scale, but if breaking items grow, push the schedule window filter into MongoDB with $or/$lte/$gte on start_at/end_at.
